About the shop

Tennis Everyday is a tennis shop at 1-A, Shilaj Sky on Shilaj Canal Road, Ahmedabad. Rackets from Head, Wilson, Babolat and Yonex, balls, racket bags, racket strings, overgrips, and the rest of your tennis equipment, all under one roof.

Weight

Heavier rackets feel steadier and add power. Lighter ones swing faster and tire the arm less. Hold a few and see which feels natural.

Head size

A larger head forgives off-centre hits. A smaller head gives more control to players who strike the ball cleanly.

Grip size

You should hold the handle without squeezing hard. A grip that is too small or too large strains the wrist.

Bags

Count the rackets you carry, then pick a bag with room for them plus balls, grips and a towel. Larger bags split rackets across separate compartments.

Reels and sets · 8 strings

Strings

String type and gauge change how a racket plays. Polyester suits hard hitters, multifilament is softer on the arm. Ask at the counter which one fits your racket.

Prices are approximate and can change. Ability is general guidance on the player level a product suits. Ask at the shop for today's price and the right fit.

Packs of 3 · 4 overgrips

Overgrips

An overgrip wraps over your racket's base grip. It soaks up sweat, adds tack and is cheap to replace, so change it often. Choose a thin, tacky one for feel or a softer one for comfort.

Prices are approximate and can change. Ability is general guidance on the player level a product suits. Ask at the shop for today's price and the right fit.
